author: haiku
reason: B opens by tying the change to the existing login and session code, then walks the flow in numbered steps that give the reason for each check (why the sid is stored as a hash, why the Settings session is re-checked, why Cancel is a POST), so a newcomer learns how the system works and why it is built that way, not just what it does.
